item.title: MiBeeSteward: From v0.1.0 to v0.5.0
item.description: MiBeeSteward is the device management and monitoring system I wrote for my own studio: one Go binary stringing network-device discovery, classification, monitoring, and management into a single line. v0.1.0 shipped on July 5, 2026; v0.5.0 landed on August 20 — five releases evolving a “single-subnet scanner” into “a distributed system that passes enterprise audits”. Each version used to have its own post; this one merges the v0.1.0–v0.5.0 release records into a single timeline: what each step did, and why.
